title: Antigravity
tagline: Gravity's gone the wrong way aboard the Helios-7 space station, and the ceiling is deadly!
blurb: Gravity's gone the wrong way aboard the Helios-7 space station, and the ceiling is deadly! Feather your down-thrust, brake hard and grab three power cores in every bay before your minute of oxygen runs out. Ten sectors on three decks, with sweeping lasers, sentry drones and an S, A, B or C rank for every bay.

review.verdict: Keep your finger on S and it will let you down gently, which is more than the ceiling will.

quote.text: SPACE is the brake and S is all that stops you sailing up into that red ceiling

credits.name: Baz Pocket, Prue Fairley and Norm Crabtree for INK & PAPER
